name: Ionasal.kkll.Preciell
original_name: イオナサル・ククルル・プリシェール
source:
"Plus, I think I'd be better at making a bomb than a pickaxe!"
Singer: [url=/s430]Akiko Shikata[/url]

Ciel Nosurge Description:
The protagonist of Ciel nosurge, and the empress candidate of the Tenmon (Astronomical faction) group. Unsure of herself, she wants to do what she can to save Ra Ciela but lacks conviction at first, especially compared to the fiery and determined [url=/c60283]Kanon[/url]. Ion is quite the gearhead, and loves tinkering with machinery.

[From [url=https://pastebin.com/egW4rhTK]Ciel Nosurge Summary[/url]]

Ar Nosurge Description:
Nicknamed Ion, her actual name is Ionasal kkll Preciell.
This girl is said to know the truths of the world. She has no allegiances to anyone, but her current location is unknown.
She is somewhat awkward, and loves to tinker with machines. 
Whenever she has the chance, she gathers strange materials together to create devices of unknown purpose.

[From the [url=http://www.arnosurge.eu/chara_04.html]English official site[/url]]
